title: 第五章 仙儿日月星辰禁第六章 七星炼道匣人级爆灵丹
content_zh:

read2（）;“咻”
元力震荡，离开慕容家的子弟院落，林无缺身形变得飘忽，他似乎认准了某一个方向，朝着那里疾行而去。
“呵呵，那个慕容冰兰似乎对你怨念不小啊。”
空略带些戏谑的声音在林无缺脑中响起，刚刚的那一幕空自然看在眼里，对于林无缺三拳打爆慕容海，他一点也不意外。
因为在刚刚过去的这一夜当中，金红气血回归肉身，圣法本源凝聚的林无缺修为终于在停滞十年之后再次提升。
锻体六重天巅峰，炼筋大成。
这便是林无缺现在的境界，但这不过是刚刚开始罢了。
圣道战气的强悍通过刚刚那一战表露无疑，横跨两个境界越阶而战并击败慕容海，就是最好的证明。
所以、若没有把握，在昨日的演武场，林无缺怎么可能去约战慕容天，一个月之后，他将会亲自将属于自己的东西拿回来。
当然，一个月实在是太短暂了，慕容天如今踏入了洗凡英魄境，凝聚魄月，其修为之强大，远非慕容海可以相比，想要击败他，并不容易。
但这也正是林无缺想要的，没有庞大的压力，怎会有无限的动力？
寂灭十年的他，像一块被时光雕琢透了的美玉，如今再度释放璀璨光芒。
“无非是幼时的一句戏言而已，昨日终于解除了婚约，倒也可以清静了，她毕竟是长青叔叔的女儿，我自然不会对她怎样。”
疾行中的林无缺回答了空的话，随即便将这件事抛诸脑后，双眼微眯，因为在他的目光尽头，是苍茫古老的原始山林。
这个地方，十年前林无缺曾经来过一次。
“空，十年过去了，日月星辰禁不知道有没有被别人发现。”
望着远方的原始山林，林无缺淡淡开口，语气中蕴含着一丝莫名。
“日月星辰禁所在的那个山洞极为的隐秘，一般人根本发现不了，当年若不是你不小心从那里掉下来，也不可能发现。”
空的回答倒是极为的肯定。

“算了，多想无益，到了自然就知道了，希望残留的月禁和星禁当中，真的会有着可以提升我修为的东西吧。”
日月星辰禁。
十年前，林无缺在日禁当中遇到了空，而剩下的月禁和星禁当中，或许同样封着极具价值的宝物。
这也是林无缺此行的目标，毕竟只有一个月，若是没有奇遇，单凭自身的苦修，纵使天资再高，也不可能成长到可以匹敌慕容天的境界，更不用说击败了。
“咻”
林无缺脚下的速度更快三分，周边的磷峋怪石不住的被他甩在身后，如此速度，不用多时，他就能去到日月星辰禁所在的山洞。
“咦？”
脚下骤然一顿，林无缺突然感觉到前方闪过一丝熟悉的波动，随即他的脸庞闪过一抹由衷的笑意。
与此同时，一声清脆动人的声音轻轻响起。
“林大哥。”
在林无缺的目光前方，一块巨大的怪石旁，一位身着洁白无瑕贴身白裙的娇俏身影盈盈而立，黑色的秀发如瀑洒在香肩之上，皮肤光华如美玉，白里透红，五官清纯秀气，一双如水的眸子里泛着喜意。

突然出现的这个少女好似从天而降的小仙女一般，十四五岁的模样，玲珑可人，红润的小嘴含笑，望着林无缺，双眼笑的如同弯月一般，极为动人。
“嗖”

Yuan Li was shaking. After leaving the Murong family's courtyard, Lin Wuque's figure became erratic. He seemed to have identified a certain direction and rushed towards it.
"Haha, that Murong Binglan seems to have a lot of resentment towards you."
Kong's slightly joking voice sounded in Lin Wuque's mind. Kong naturally saw the scene just now. He was not surprised at all when Lin Wuque defeated Murong Hai with three punches.
Because in the night that just passed, the golden red energy and blood returned to the physical body, and Lin Wuque's cultivation, which was condensed from the source of the holy law, finally improved again after ten years of stagnation.
The sixth level of physical training is at its peak, and the muscles are perfected.
This is Lin Wuque's current state, but this is just the beginning.
The strength of the holy way's fighting spirit was clearly demonstrated through the battle just now. Fighting across two realms and defeating Murong Hai was the best proof.
Therefore, if he was not sure, how could Lin Wuque go to fight Murong Tian in yesterday's martial arts arena? A month later, he would personally get back what belongs to him.
Of course, one month is too short. Murong Tian has now entered the Pure Soul Realm and condensed the Soul Moon. His cultivation is far more powerful than Murong Hai can compare with. It is not easy to defeat him.
But this is exactly what Lin Wuque wants. Without huge pressure, how can there be unlimited motivation?
He has been silent for ten years, like a piece of beautiful jade carved by time, and now he is shining brightly again.
"It's nothing more than a joke from childhood. The engagement was finally terminated yesterday, so I can be quiet. She is Uncle Changqing's daughter after all. Naturally, I won't do anything to her."
Lin Wuque, who was walking quickly, answered Kong's words, then put the matter behind him, and narrowed his eyes slightly, because at the end of his sight was the vast ancient primitive mountain forest.
Lin Wuque had been to this place ten years ago.
"Song, ten years have passed, and I don't know if Sun Moon Star has been discovered by others."
Looking at the primitive mountain forest in the distance, Lin Wuque spoke calmly, with a hint of inexplicability in his tone.
"The cave where the Sun, Moon and Stars Forbidden City is located is extremely secretive and cannot be discovered by ordinary people. If you hadn't accidentally fallen from there, you wouldn't have been able to discover it."
Sora's answer was extremely positive.
"Forget it, it's useless to think too much. You'll know it when you get there. I hope there will really be something in the remaining Moon Forbidden and Star Forbidden that can improve my cultivation."
The sun, moon and stars are forbidden.
Ten years ago, Lin Wuque met Kong in the Sun Forbidden City, and the remaining Moon Forbidden City and Star Forbidden City may also contain valuable treasures.
This was also the goal of Lin Wuque's trip. After all, it was only one month. If there were no adventures, just relying on his own hard work, no matter how talented he was, he would not be able to grow to a level that could rival Murong Tian, ​​let alone defeat him.
"Whoops"
Lin Wuque's foot speed was three points faster, and the surrounding jagged rocks could not help but be left behind by him. With such speed, he could reach the cave where the Sun, Moon and Stars were forbidden in no time.
"Huh?"
His feet suddenly stopped, and Lin Wuque suddenly felt a familiar wave flashing in front of him, and then a heartfelt smile flashed across his face.
At the same time, a clear and moving voice sounded softly.
"Brother Lin."
In front of Lin Wuque's gaze, beside a huge strange rock, stood a charming figure in a flawless white dress. Her black hair fell like a waterfall on her shoulders, her skin was as shiny as jade, white and rosy, her facial features were pure and delicate, and her watery eyes were filled with joy.
